description: Lists ProfitDrawer products (spreadsheets, printables, templates, planners and printed goods) with name, price in USD, file formats, availability, product page URL and Etsy listing URL. Optional filters: words to match, collection, maximum price and file format.

collection.description: Collection: money = Money & Budget; business-templates = Business Templates & Kits; planners = Planners; kids = Kids & Family; bookkeeping-spreadsheets = Bookkeeping Spreadsheets; printed = Printed Goods.

format.description: File format to match, for example "Google Sheets", "Excel", "PDF", "PowerPoint". Matched as text, case-insensitive.

max_price.description: Only products at or below this price in USD.

query.description: Words to match in the product name, type or collection, for example "cleaning bookkeeping".

name: list_products
title: List ProfitDrawer products
